description: List the shared groups in an organization — a group is a reusable bag of secrets (a shared datastore, a vendor account) that many application environments can compose in rather than duplicating. Use it to find the `group` slug compose_group and list_group_envs take. Returns [{ id, orgId, name, slug, createdAt }]; not paginated.

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

name: list_groups
